data_fields.name: group_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 once 2 or more pieces (per attacker for us, capped at 3)

data_fields.name: follow_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 8.0 per second (fraction = delta x 8, unclamped in donor)

data_fields.name: zoom_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 2.0 per second (fraction = delta x 2, unclamped in donor)

best_idea: Frame a player's group by the mass-weighted centre of its pieces and widen the view from the group's size (one fixed step once it has more than one piece), so the camera tracks a many-part fight without a fixed zoom.
decision_why: Take the group centroid framing and the size-driven zoom with a fixed step per attacker (cap 3); reject the mass term (no mass in Frankendom) and the unclamped lerp; the donor frames its own pieces, so the enemy term is ours to design.
acceptance: In a zone fight the camera holds one rest framing for the hero alone; with one, two and three attackers engaged the frame widens by a fixed step per attacker, the centre moves to the weighted middle of hero and attackers, and a client test asserts zoom is monotone in attacker count and every follow or zoom fraction is clamped to 1.
